page.layout: One printed page. Title block at the top, centred. Below it a two-column index: on the left the Old and New Testament references with their page numbers, and on the right a second column of references, continuing the list, with its page numbers at the far right. The signature "Aaa 3" stands at the foot, right of centre.

main_text.head: LOCORVM SACRAE SCRIPTVRAE QVI IN HOC THESAVRO elucidantur,
ELENCHVS.

page.notes: The index is set in two columns that run together on the scan; the cell order follows the reading order of the printed rows. The middle column's chapter and verse references are partly hard to separate from the page numbers in the scan; the separation shown is my best reading. The signature reads "Aaa 3".
